problem.title: Free Fall Motion
problem.description: A problem about objects falling under gravity
problem.statement: A ball is dropped from a height of 100 meters. Assuming no air resistance and g=9.8 m/s², calculate the time it takes to hit the ground.

conversationHistory.content: I don't know where to start with this problem.
What do we know from the problem statement?
The height is 100 m, the initial velocity is 0 and a = 9.8 m/s².
